units: <cite ref="Mishnah Taanit 2:1">Taan. II, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Taanit 15a:4">15ᵃ</cite>) <he>מוציאין … לרְחוֹבָהּ של עיר</he> (not <he>לרחוב</he>) (at public fasts) they carry the ark out to the open place of the town.

<cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 3:1">Meg. III, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Megillah 25b:20">25ᵇ</cite>) <he>בני … רחובה וכ׳</he> if the citizens sold the open place of a town (which is used for public prayer meetings), they may buy a synagogue with the proceeds.
<cite ref="Megillah 25b:20">Ib.</cite> <he>בה״כ … את הר׳</he> if they sold a synagogue, they dare not buy an open place; a. e.
